handoff_payload.answer_text: Gross margin is not a useful metric for American Express because, as a financial-services company, its economics are driven by interest income and expense, credit-loss provisions, and operating expenses rather than a conventional cost of goods sold. In FY2022, interest income grew 40.1% and interest expense 115.4%, producing 27.7% net interest-income growth; revenues net of interest expense rose 24.7%, but rose only 15.7% after provisions, which increased by USD 3,601 million, while total expenses grew 24.1%.
